senses.gloss:
n. (-र्य्यं)
1 Incontinence.
2 Coition.
E.
अ neg. and ब्रह्मचर्य्य the duty of the religious student, i. e. chastity; also with कन् added अब्रह्मचर्य्यक n. (-कं.)

n. (-ण्यं)
Sacred, not to be killed, (in theatrical language.)
E.
अ not, ब्रह्मण्य proper for a Brahman, i. e. death; also अब्राह्मण्य.
